title: Ops demos and listing: one press gives one demo job, a failed copy is torn down before a retry, removals settle, Listing unlocks from the Road, and Create listing no longer hangs on a third-party request
steps: Run the harness ops-templates-feedback tests against the Demos, ReleaseDemo, TemplateDetail and DesignInspiration screens.
Run the tracy-web ops-demos, ops-quickstarts and card-draft tests against a scratch PostgreSQL schema.
Run the tracy-host capture tests with a page whose load event never fires.
expect: After a failed job, a new install holds every press until the new job is known, and a 409 DEMO_BUSY is printed without following anything.
A second install while one is in flight is refused by name and starts nothing; two installs arriving together start one job.
A retry after a failed install tears the broken copy down first, then provisions the new one.
The stale-copy refusal has a short guide and the card offers Remove; two presses send one DELETE; other failures keep Retry install alone.
A removal reads Removing while it runs and Not installed once done, also when the server no longer knows the job, and a screen opened mid-removal reads it as a removal from deployed.kind.
Once the demo is live the next page read unlocks the Listing card, following the same road the Road to live shows.
Generate card answers a Tracy reason (424 OUTLINE_FAILED) when the host cannot read the demo or never answers, never a bare gateway status, and the harness says it in words.
A model that fails, times out or never answers still returns the layouts that were read, with category and blurb empty and a why.
tracy-host outlines and shoots a page whose load never fires from its DOM with bounded waits, instead of failing at the goto limit.
fence: Third-party requests in tracy-host captures get 5 s and are aborted; the site's own origin is never cut; goto waits for domcontentloaded and load/network idle are bounded graces.

tests: 1: after a failed job, a new install holds every press until the new job is known
1: the door saying a job is already running is printed, and nothing is followed
2: the stale-copy refusal has a guide, short and with no dashes
2: a demo that failed on the old copy offers Remove on the card; two presses send one DELETE
2: any other failure keeps the card to Retry install alone
3, 4: a removal reads "Removing…" while it runs, then "Not installed" once it is done
4: a removal whose job the server no longer knows still settles to "Not installed"
3: a screen opened mid-removal reads it as a removal
5: once the demo is live, the next page read unlocks the Listing card without F5
5: the lock follows the road the page drew, the same answer the Road to live shows
6: a gateway page instead of an answer is said in words, never "the door answered 502"
6: the door’s own reason is printed as it is
a second install while one is in flight is refused by name and starts nothing
two installs that arrive together start one job between them
a retry after a failed install tears the broken copy down first, then builds the new one
the listing says what kind of job is in flight, so a reload mid-removal reads as a removal
Generate card: a demo the host could not read answers a Tracy reason, never a bare gateway status
Generate card: a host that never answers is a Tracy reason too
Generate card: a model that fails or times out still answers the layouts that were read
a model that never answers is given up on, and says so
makeOutline: a page whose load never fires is still outlined from its DOM, with bounded waits
makeShoot: a page whose load never fires is shot with what has painted, not failed
